notes.title: "VIRTUA UNLIMITED PROJECT" Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

"Virtua Unlimited Project" has been on sale for nearly two months now. During these two months, the production team has been continuously receiving feedback from you, the players, and performing maintenance.
In addition to this, we have also been updating the game's content.

1. [New] Added EX·Boss Rush to the training machine, where you challenge all bosses in succession; dying midway ends the attempt (Note: In this mode, there will be no restoration of health and support value between DG's first and second phases).
2. [New] Added a portrait painting gallery to Leonid Castle, and all portrait painting enemies within the level will become random portraits.
3. [New] Added achievements related to Boss Rush and the portrait painting gallery.
4. [BUG]Fixed issues with the progress bar and looping for some tracks in the original soundtrack system.
5. [New] Added several pieces of fanart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/212f7e8b2d7b410b0d7d86275fcd058f774bb358.png

Thank you all for your support of "Virtua Unlimited Project" We will continue to work hard to produce even better content!

notes.title: Release Date Announce!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are very pleased to announce Virtua Unlimited Project's release time: 

8pm PST | 11pm EST | 13am JST, APR 25, 2024

[previewyoutube=7SWDXK_WO-A;full][/previewyoutube]

The game supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/97326debd04f9f2542c7ddcd6aa564d8b11eda85.png

Since the stretch goals in our crowdfunding have been reached, a special website about VRS studio will launch on APR 15. Make an appointment to the studio to explore more interesting stuff about the game.

Kickstarter：Virtua Unlimited Project

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/660d57cb3b3f636f87a398264b4ead9219cff1c7.gif

The release includes 13 levels, 20 extensions, lots of collectibles, and some beautiful CG. More modes promised in the crowdfunding will be added in the future, including OST, artbook, Boss Rush, and Time mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42122267/3d0d8b0c19699cbf9652e23ded81368810df59d4.png

The demo is still available on Steam now with 3 levels. Welcome to play!

Thanks for everyone's support. Hope you will enjoy the game, and give a wishlist before the final release!
